description:
Stop `scripts/benchmark-rust-build.sh` discarding earlier samples when it never gets the build lock.

## Background

`init_empty_jsonl` truncates `raw/clean-samples.jsonl` and `raw/rebuild-samples.jsonl` (line 585) before the script first takes the build lock (line 603). Since d6635a93 the wait has a bound, so a timeout now exits with the committed samples already emptied and a `target.*` directory left behind.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A run that never holds the build lock leaves the existing sample files unchanged, and a timeout at any acquisition leaves no `target.*` directory.
- [hard] REQ-02: A timeout after the run first held the lock exits non-zero with a message naming how many samples were written.
title: A benchmark run that never gets the build lock keeps its earlier samples
